content: According to MK, Ṣāʾin al-Dīn sent a letter from Isfahan to Yazd, to be communicated to Shāhrukh by Niʿmat Allāh, in reply to Shāhrukh's summons to attend his court; in it he conveys admiration and good wishes to the newly ascendant Shāhrukh and assures him he will soon attend. MK links the letter to Niʿmat Allāh's visit to Shiraz in 816/1413-14 at the invitation of Iskandar Mīrzā (given on pdf p.244), which he says appears to have bracketed Shāhrukh's campaign in western Iran and Iskandar's removal; MK does not give the letter itself a date.
refers_to_primary: Munshaʾāt-i Turka, letter 16 (TMN/M f. 148a; TMN/MS pp. 11-12; TMN/D pp. 170-73)
